clips.title: The story
paras: South of Darnassus, the Pools of Arlithrien have grown dangerous and neglected. Their moonwell once drew night elves to a quiet sanctuary, but beasts and nearby Gnarlpine furbolgs now threaten the springs.

The Pools of Arlithrien lie beneath Teldrassil’s shaded boughs, south of Darnassus. A stone moonwell rests at their heart, holding waters touched by Elune’s grace. Though the sanctuary lies near the night elven capital, danger has driven the night elves to leave it untended. Agitated beasts roam the shallows, and the Gnarlpine furbolgs nearby remain hostile. What was meant to be a peaceful retreat now reflects the growing troubles across the island.
